lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, who eat the fat and wear the wool but do not feed the flock.
The shepherds ruled the flock with violence and cruelty, so the scattered sheep became food for wild beasts on the mountains.
The LORD will remove the shepherds, then search for His flock himself and bring them from the countries into their own fortress.
The LORD will judge between fat and lean sheep, save His flock, and appoint one shepherd over them, His servant Moses.
God will make a covenant of peace, send showers of blessing, and call the flock His people.
